description: mice.impute.polyreg(y, ry, x, wy, nnet.maxit = maxit, nnet.MaxNWts = max_weights) with its uniform numbers captured: uniforms = runif(n_imp), order the expected sequence of draws as [pool, count] pairs. value, convergence and coef come from the nnet::multinom fit (coef: one row per fitted class but the first, one column per column of [1, x]; nnet's bias weights left out); fitted_levels are its classes, prob the probabilities of the port's levels in each imputed cell (0 for a level without an observed row), levels the port's level order and imputed the port's labels. Inputs: kind, y (labels; null for NA), levels (declared), ry, wy (null means !ry), x without intercept (null when p = 0). port: 'match' (R's result), 'rebuilt' (R stops, r_error; the port's computation rebuilt with mice's augment and nnet::multinom) or 'value_error' (R and the port stop; r_error). multinom_cases: nnet::multinom(y ~ ., weights) on the model matrix x with 0-based classes y; prob the predicted probabilities of the rows new_x.
